title: Authenticated web application
planning: Separate authentication from authorization: every server route must verify both identity and access to the requested resource.
Centralize session and database helpers; do not create a new database client in each route or export framework-invalid values from route modules.
Return only fields the current user is allowed to see, especially participant identity, account, and financial data.
Require explicit confirmation and CSRF-safe methods for destructive account or membership actions.
checks: Test unauthenticated, authenticated-but-not-authorized, missing-resource, and successful requests for each changed route.
Test direct API access independently of page middleware; client redirects are not authorization controls.
Verify secrets remain server-only and required authentication configuration fails clearly when absent.
review: Look for ownership filters that only narrow nested relations while still returning the parent resource.
Look for host-header-derived internal requests, over-broad ORM includes, account deletion without relational handling, and user identifiers sourced from unvalidated client input.
